assertion: An event exists, described as "Bulgaria wins Eurovision".
judge_quote: Bulgaria won the Eurovision Song Contest on Sunday with Dara's catchy floor-filler "Bangaranga"
evidence_cited: Bulgaria won the Eurovision Song Contest on Sunday with Dara's catchy floor-filler "Bangaranga" sweeping the 70th edition of the world's biggest live televised music event and pushing into second place Israel, whose participation had triggered a major boycott.

Bulgaria has missed the last three editions of the glitzy extravaganza but took the crown in Vienna for the first time ever, overtaking Israel at the very end as the points came in, with Romania finishing third.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Israel finishes second".
judge_quote: pushing into second place Israel
evidence_cited: Bulgaria won the Eurovision Song Contest on Sunday with Dara's catchy floor-filler "Bangaranga" sweeping the 70th edition of the world's biggest live televised music event and pushing into second place Israel, whose participation had triggered a major boycott.
Bulgaria finished with 516 points, ahead of Israel on 343, Romania on 296, Australia on 287, Italy with 281 and Finland on 279.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Romania finishes third".
judge_quote: with Romania finishing third.
evidence_cited: Bulgaria has missed the last three editions of the glitzy extravaganza but took the crown in Vienna for the first time ever, overtaking Israel at the very end as the points came in, with Romania finishing third.
Bulgaria finished with 516 points, ahead of Israel on 343, Romania on 296, Australia on 287, Italy with 281 and Finland on 279.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Australia finishes fourth".
justification: article does not state Australia finished fourth
evidence_cited: Australia's Delta Goodrem, who has sold nine million albums, came fourth after wowing the crowds with her song "Eclipse", which was filled with strong moments, ending with her soaring high on a riser coming up out of a glittering piano.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Countries boycott Eurovision".
judge_quote: Spain, the Netherlands, Ireland, Iceland and Slovenia staged the biggest political boycott in Eurovision history over Israel's participation
evidence_cited: Spain, the Netherlands, Ireland, Iceland and Slovenia staged the biggest political boycott in Eurovision history over Israel's participation, citing the war in Gaza.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Protesters march against Israel".
judge_quote: Hundreds of protesters against Israel's inclusion marched near the contest arena before Saturday's final
evidence_cited: Hundreds of protesters against Israel's inclusion marched near the contest arena before Saturday's final, some holding placards saying "Block Eurovision".
Pro-Palestinian groups also staged an outdoor concert on Friday under the banner "No stage for genocide".
